chapters.title: Cyrus's Decree of Return
chapters.synopsis: Cyrus, king of Persia, stirred by the Lord, decrees that the Jewish exiles may return to Jerusalem and rebuild the temple. He restores the sacred vessels Nebuchadnezzar had taken, and the people prepare to go up with gifts from their neighbors.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: The Lord stirs Cyrus's spirit

segments.speaker: cyrus
segments.note: Cyrus proclaims that the exiles may return

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Vessels restored; the people prepare to leave

chapters.title: The Register of Returning Exiles
chapters.synopsis: Ezra records the families, priests, and Levites who return from Babylon to Judah under Zerubbabel. The list totals the people, servants, and singers, and notes gifts given toward rebuilding the temple.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: The census of those who return from exile

chapters.title: The Altar and Temple Foundation
chapters.synopsis: The returned exiles rebuild the altar and restore the daily sacrifices despite their fear of surrounding peoples. When the temple's foundation is laid, the people shout for joy while older priests weep at the memory of the first temple.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: The altar rebuilt; sacrifices restored

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: The temple foundation laid amid joy and weeping

chapters.title: Adversaries Halt the Work
chapters.synopsis: Enemies of Judah offer false help and then hire counselors to frustrate the rebuilding of the temple. Later opponents write to the Persian king accusing Jerusalem of rebellion, and the work stops until the reign of Darius.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Adversaries hinder the rebuilding

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Letters accuse Jerusalem before the king

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: The work ceases until Darius's reign

chapters.title: The Prophets Stir the Work Anew
chapters.synopsis: Encouraged by the prophets, Zerubbabel and Jeshua resume building the temple despite governors' questions. The Persian governor Tattenai writes to Darius asking whether Cyrus truly authorized the work.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: The prophets urge the work forward

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Tattenai questions the builders' authority

chapters.title: The Temple Finished and Dedicated
chapters.synopsis: Darius finds Cyrus's decree and commands that the temple work continue at his own expense, threatening any who hinder it. The temple is completed, dedicated with sacrifice and joy, and the returned exiles keep the Passover together.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Darius confirms Cyrus's decree

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: The temple is finished and dedicated

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: The people keep the Passover

chapters.title: Ezra Journeys to Jerusalem
chapters.synopsis: Ezra, a priest and scribe skilled in the law of Moses, receives broad authority from king Artaxerxes to teach and judge in Judah. He blesses the Lord for putting it in the king's heart to honor the house of God.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Ezra's lineage and devotion to the law

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Artaxerxes grants Ezra authority

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Ezra blesses the Lord for His favor

chapters.title: Ezra Leads the Exiles Home
chapters.synopsis: Ezra gathers the families who will return with him and proclaims a fast to seek a safe journey without a military escort. They arrive safely in Jerusalem, deliver the temple treasures, and offer sacrifices of thanksgiving.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: The company of returning exiles listed

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Ezra proclaims a fast for a safe journey

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Safe arrival; treasures delivered and offerings made

chapters.title: Ezra Mourns Israel's Intermarriage
chapters.synopsis: Ezra learns that many Israelites, including leaders, have intermarried with the peoples of the land against the Lord's command. Appalled, he tears his clothing and offers a humble, anguished prayer confessing the nation's guilt.

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Ezra learns of the people's intermarriage

segments.speaker: ezra
segments.note: Ezra's prayer of confession and shame

chapters.title: The Covenant to Put Away Foreign Wives
chapters.synopsis: Moved by Ezra's grief, the people covenant to put away their foreign wives and children in obedience to the law. Ezra assembles the men of Judah, and over three months the matter is investigated and a list of offenders is recorded.
